design: Before any full-day build/fit readout: report 10s gain/loss/risk means and errors for all existing families, paired day intervals for queue calibrated versus raw/market calibrated/training baseline, fixed score bins (-inf,-5,0,5,inf) in cents, and KEEP/PULL value decomposition on each declared zero-threshold kept subset. Positive aggregation and changed-sign refusal controls. No new fit, candidate, threshold or population.
